title: acceptance-verdict.v1
description: Derived acceptance verdict from the satisfaction evaluator. Every verdict traces to criteria and receipts. Unknown verdict value remains unsatisfied. Contradiction precedes support; a missing observation is insufficient. Core policy owners approve semantics; consumers reject unknown major versions and recompute after reader upgrade.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Consumers reject unknown major versions and recompute after reader upgrade.

evaluation_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint over the input criteria and receipts. Identical inputs produce the same verdict.

verdict.description: Acceptance verdict. Evaluated in order: unapproved (no current approval), contradicted (contradiction true), supported (contradiction false, satisfaction true), insufficient (contradiction false, satisfaction false).

criteria_refs.description: References to the acceptance-property.v1 records evaluated. Every verdict traces to criteria.

receipt_refs.description: References to the evidence-receipt.v1 records evaluated. Every verdict traces to receipts.
